summary: runProcess: sync spawn throw (EINVAL on .cmd bins, Node CVE-2024-27980 guard) escaped as a promise rejection - drivers threw, and an available() probe crash could kill 'harness run' before any run record existed
repro_command: HARNESS_CODEX_BIN=%APPDATA%\npm\codex.cmd node dist/cli.js run 'task' (pre-fix: 'error: spawn EINVAL', exit 1, no run folder, no PARKED.md)
prevention_layer: proc.ts try/catch around spawn -> resolve spawnError; Engine.isAvailable try/catch (probe crash can never kill the CLI pre-run)
regression_test: harness/tests/proc.test.ts 'sync spawn throw (.cmd...) resolves with spawnError'; harness/tests/codex-driver.test.ts '.cmd override... resolves... instead of rejecting' (win32)
